Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Subject: Intimation regarding receipt of Work Order 
 
Ref.: Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
 
We are pleased to inform that the Company has secured a significant order of Provision of Integrated Service 
contract for O&M of Cairn Assets for RJ-ON-90/1 Block for RJ North Well Pads Across Mangala, Bhagyam and 
Aishwarya at Rajasthan worth Rs. 641,92,12,546 /- (Rupees Six Hundred Forty One Crore, Ninety Two Lakh, 
Twelve Thousand, Five Hundred and Forty Six).   
 
This order marks a significant milestone in the Company’s growth journey and aligns with its strategic focus on 
expanding its presence in high-value, long-term O&M and integrated service contracts within the oil & gas 
sector. It further strengthens the Company’s positioning as a reliable and preferred service partner for marquee 
clients, while enhancing its visibility in strategically important energy assets. 
 
The contract is expected to provide strong revenue visibility over the execution period, improve the stability, 
and contribute positively to margins through efficient resource deployment and operational synergies. 
Additionally, it reinforces the Company’s unwavering commitment to operational excellence, safety standards, 
and service quality, which remain the cornerstone of its business philosophy. Overall, this development is a 
testament to the Company’s dedicated efforts towards sustainable growth, disciplined execution, and value 
creation. 
 
In accordance with the Regulation 30 read with the Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the relevant particulars as required under the SEBI Circular No. 
HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026 and any other relevant circulars, are 
provided in Annexure hereto. 
 
We request you to kindly take note of these details and disseminate.  
 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For Lakshya Powertech Limited 
 
 
 
Akash Patel 
Company Secretary &  
Compliance Officer
